locatorbar.config.title: Locator bar
locatorbar.commands.help.title: === Locator Bar Help ===
locatorbar.commands.help.usage: Use: /locatorbar help <option> to get details about an option.
locatorbar.commands.help.showCoordinates: Displays player coordinates on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.showDays.desc: Displays the number of world days on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.showWorldDirect: Displays world directions (N, S, E, W, etc.).
locatorbar.commands.help.playerMarkerTyp: Method of showing other players on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.maxVisiblePlaye: Maximum number of concurrently visible players on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.playerMarkerFad: Distance (in blocks) at which other players' markers start to fade.
Distance (in blocks) at which other players' markers reach minimum transparency.
locatorbar.commands.help.playerMarkerHid: Distance (in blocks) at which other players' markers disappear. Can be set to 'inf' for infinity.
locatorbar.commands.help.playerMarkerMin: Minimum visibility (in percent) of player markers at maximum fade distance.
locatorbar.commands.help.showWaypoints.d: Whether waypoints from compasses should be visible on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.maxVisibleWaypo: Maximum number of concurrently visible waypoints on the bar.
locatorbar.commands.help.showDeathWaypoi: Whether a waypoint should appear at the player's death location upon death.
